The problem

IFC models change constantly. Project decisions rarely see the change clearly enough.

Design teams release new model versions throughout the project. Without structured comparison, coordination meetings depend on manual checking, fragmented comments and assumptions about what has actually changed.

🔁

Model versions multiply

Disciplines issue new IFC files continuously, but teams lack a repeatable way to understand the delta between releases.

📍

Impact is hard to locate

Technical changes need to be translated into project-level implications: where they occurred, who is affected and what should be reviewed next.

⏱

Late detection is costly

Changes found late can affect procurement, prefabrication, site sequencing and coordination work. Earlier visibility creates time to respond.

Workflow

A new IFC change management workflow

BIMSpect is not just a model viewer. It creates a repeatable workflow for comparing model versions, understanding change impact and preparing management-level design coordination decisions.

01

Model comparison

Upload two or more IFC versions and detect added, deleted and modified objects across the project.

02

Change understanding

Structure changes by discipline, object type, floor, system or other project-relevant categories.

03

Risk prioritisation

Highlight possible coordination concerns and changes that may require review before procurement or site work.

04

Management reporting

Generate reports that support BIM coordination meetings, design management reviews and client communication.

Review changes faster. Discuss the right issues earlier.

Security & data

How we handle your project files

IFC models contain sensitive project information. We take data handling seriously and answer the questions B2B buyers need answered.

📁

What files can you upload?

IFC files (IFC2x3, IFC4). No proprietary format lock-in. Files are accepted in standard open-format exchange packages.

🌍

Where is data processed?

Processing takes place within the EU. We will specify the exact data centre location on request.

🗑

Is data stored or deleted?

Project files are used solely for producing the requested analysis. Deletion schedules and retention periods are agreed per contract.

🤝

NDA and DPA

Non-disclosure agreements and data processing agreements are available for all professional access tiers. Contact us to arrange before uploading any sensitive files.

🔒

Who sees your files?

Only the BIMSpect team processes your models, solely for the purposes stated in your access agreement. No third-party access without written consent.

🚫

Personal data

We do not intentionally collect personal data from IFC files. If models contain personal information, this should be noted in the access request.

🛡

We do not use customer project files for marketing, public examples, benchmarking or AI model training without written permission. Your models remain yours. We process them for the analysis you requested and nothing else.

About

About BIMSpect

BIMSpect originated from an Aalto University Research to Business project and is being commercialised as an independent software company. Our focus is on making IFC model change analysis practically useful for construction project management — not just for BIM specialists.
